title: 🆕 EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' confirmed for late October 2026
body: Bandai has confirmed EB-05 for around 30–31 Oct 2026 (JP ¥240 per 6-card pack; EN $4.99 per 12-card pack). Revealed so far: a Nico Robin Leader (Green/Yellow), SP Nami & Robin, and leader parallels for Vivi, Shirahoshi, Hancock, Rebecca and Bonney — while the first Heroines set (EB-03) is still sold out. Also announced: OP-18 'The Dominance of God', estimated ~November.
